grounding.name: claim paraphrased from the transcript is grounded
grounding.claim: Suction line frosted back to the compressor; return grille barely moving; filter clean.

sources.text: Hold on. Look at that suction line, it's frosted all the way back to the compressor.
Grille's barely moving. Filter's clean though, she said she changed it after the last guy.
Frost plus a weak return says the evaporator is starving for air, not for refrigerant. I measure total external static before I touch the gauges.
